newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Road Builder looking at Africa projects.
newsitem.headline: Road Builder looking at Africa projects.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer Road Builder (M) Holdings Bhd said on Friday it was looking at getting involved in construction projects in South Africa.
"At the moment, it looks like our next destination will be South Africa," said Ahmad Rithauddeen, executive chairman of Road Builder.

He was speaking to reporters at a news conference after the company's extraordinary general meeting in Kuala Lumpur. "We always believe we should do what we know best. That will be the kind of projects (in South Africa)," said Chua Hock Chin, managing director of Road Builder.
The company is already involved in road construction projects in India and Vietnam, in addition to several road and housing construction projects in Malaysia.

"We are looking at South Africa as a country we can possibly invest in, but we are going in with our eyes open, after identifying a local partner," said Yeoh Hong Hwang, Road Builder's general manager of corporate affairs.
Ahmad Rithauddeen said the company might also consider projects in South America. He did not give any further details.
